title: The Scale of Universalization in Multiplicative Kantian Equilibrium
abstract: arXiv:2610.28180v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiplicative Kantian equilibrium requires agents to evaluate whether they would prefer all players to change their actions by a common proportional factor. This note argues that such a counterfactual is not fully specified by the material payoff environment alone: one must also specify the scale in which proportional universalization is performed. Building on the Sher-Roemer discussion of strategic non-invariance, we characterize how a smooth monotone reparametrization of actions changes the multiplicative Kantian first-order condition. We then illustrate the issue in a simple two-country abatement problem. Universalizing physical abatement and universalizing abatement expenditures are both natural interpretations of "doing one's part," but they lead to different Kantian outcomes, even though they describe the same material environment. The note also identifies special cases in which the interior first-order condition is representation

translated_title: 乘性康德均衡中普遍化的尺度问题
translated_abstract: 乘性康德均衡要求行为人评估自己是否更倾向于所有参与者以一个共同的比例因子改变其行动。本文指出，这一反事实情景并不能仅由物质收益环境完全确定：还必须指明进行比例普遍化时所采用的尺度。基于Sher与Roemer关于策略非不变性的讨论，我们刻画了行动的光滑单调重参数化如何改变乘性康德均衡的一阶条件。随后，我们通过一个简单的两国减排问题来阐释这一问题：普遍化物理减排量与普遍化减排支出都是“尽自己一份力”的自然解释，但二者会导致不同的康德均衡结果，尽管它们描述的是同一个物质环境。本文还识别了一些特殊情形，在这些情形下内点一阶条件具有表示不变性。
tldr: 本文指出乘性康德均衡中的比例普遍化依赖于所选取的行动尺度——同一物质环境在不同尺度（如物理减排量与减排支出）下会得出不同的均衡结果——并刻画了尺度重参数化对一阶条件的影响以及结果保持不变的特殊情形。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that proportional universalization in multiplicative Kantian equilibrium depends on the chosen action scale—different scales describing the same material environment yield different Kantian outcomes—and characterizes how smooth monotone reparametrizations alter the first-order condition, along with special cases where the result is scale-invariant.
